note: The ecosystem compatibility record of @abap2ui5/linter, generated by scripts/generate-compat.mjs (npm run generate-compat) and gated by npm test - never hand-edit. "linter" is this package's version. "framework.minimum" is the oldest abap2UI5 release whose released client API the rules assume (z2ui5_cl_ui5_view_builder, client->get_event( )) - an app on an older release is not one this linter can judge. "framework.mirrored" is the abap2UI5 release the hand-maintained mirrors in lib/ (frontend-actions, formatters, released-api, cc-controls, the cs_event fixture) were last synced against - a newer framework may have wires or objects the linter does not know yet (scripts/check-upstream.mjs reports that drift). "ui5.floor" is the default UI5 version the gate judges against (--ui5), "ui5.snapshot" the version the metadata snapshot in data/properties.json was generated at - the gate knows nothing newer. Read it through the package exports map as @abap2ui5/linter/compat: app-template's check-pin and doctor scripts compare their framework pin against it, the VS Code extension reads it to say which framework line a bundled linter understands. Regenerated on every linter release (the version), on a mirror sync (npm run generate-compat -- --local <abap2UI5 checkout>) and on a snapshot bump.
